what_this_is: Facts about this repository's own history and about a re-run of the novelty gate, recorded on 2026-11-23 so the paper can state them without typing them. None is a measurement of the corpus.

github.note: The first public copy of the freeze dates from this day, after the one-factory pilot of docs/DECISIONS.md D061 and D069 had run. No signed tag, no external registry and no third-party timestamp exists for the freeze.
